tagline:
Archive your dream today.
Break it into steps you can do.
spoken: [hook] Monday won't fix it. || We love a fresh start. Next Monday, then the first of the month, then January. And every time, the start date moves again. || Here's the thing. Monday doesn't change anything. You'll have the same goal, the same doubts, just less time. || [turn] So start today, but start small. Pick the first step of your goal that fits in fifteen minutes. Want to change jobs? Update one section of your CV tonight. || Then tomorrow, do the next step, and the next. By the time Monday comes, you're not starting from zero. You're already a few steps in. || [land] A fresh start isn't a date. It's the first step you actually take. || [outro] That's what Dmyor is for. You archive your dream today, so you can see it tomorrow, and break it down into small steps you can actually do. || [outro] If you want to try it out, I've put the link in the bio.
